title: Pineapple: modeled ₹205/qtl left, Kattappana → Kondotty
summary: February 2021: reported pineapple prices at Kattappana and Kondotty imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 85% of 13 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹205 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 84 same-variety market pairs screened for pineapple in February 2021; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (Medium) at both markets; sale matched to the first Kondotty report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: February 2021
scenes.caption: Kattappana (Kerala) and Kondotty (Kerala) both reported pineapple prices for the same variety and grade (Medium) on 13 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Kattappana reported a median ₹2,400 per quintal. Kondotty reported a median ₹3,000 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹600/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹600 per quintal, and Kondotty was dearer on 100% of days.

scenes.headline: 278 km by road
scenes.caption: 278 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~4 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹60/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹254 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹88 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Kondotty report, the rule selects 13 of 13 modeled shipping days. 11 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹205 per quintal (₹42 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Pineapple route from Kattappana to Kondotty was positive on 85% of matched days in February 2021. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹20,500, or ₹4,200 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to pineapple
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹60/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Pineapple route from Kattappana to Kondotty was positive on 85% of matched days in February 2021. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹20,500, or ₹4,200 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.
